prediction_window.description: 以完整摘除全部风险警示的官方生效日2021-05-12为预测起点，至2025-05-12止的48个自然月，含起止日

target.definition: 公司股票完整撤销全部ST或*ST风险警示正式生效后48个自然月内，是否至少开始一次新的、独立的ST或*ST风险警示episode。只有此前已完整退出风险警示状态后再次正式进入才计数；同一episode内ST与*ST互转、叠加警示或部分撤销不另计。

criteria.description: 完整摘除全部风险警示生效后48个自然月内，至少开始一次新的独立ST或*ST episode

prompt: 你处在2021-05-11收盘后的信息环境。交易所已批准ST金花撤销全部其他风险警示，2021-05-12生效。请预测至2025-05-12（含）是否会开始新的独立ST或*ST episode。请综合资金占用整改、财务韧性和控制治理变化，严格遵守48个月边界，不要用窗口外事实作推理输入。给出概率、二元判断、证据ID和简短可审计推理。

authoring_provenance.row_policy: stock_code=600080.XSHG; as_of=full-removal announcement info_date 2021-05-11; prediction starts at official full-removal change_date 2021-05-12; window_end=same month/day plus 4 calendar years, inclusive
authoring_provenance.episode_rule: Sort daily is_st by stock/date. A new episode starts only on False-to-True after a prior False interval; ST-to-*ST, *ST-to-ST, additive warnings and partial removal inside an uninterrupted True interval are one episode. Official announcement change_date is label authority.
authoring_provenance.governance_matching_axis: controller and chairman changed after as_of; matching feature only, not a management-quality label
authoring_provenance.outcome_contract: Official full-removal change_date starts the inclusive 48-calendar-month clock; only an official later change_date starting a new independent ST/*ST episode on or before window_end counts.
authoring_provenance.date_discrepancy_policy: An is_st flip on a suspension day before the official effective/resumption date is retained only as a dataset discrepancy; official change_date controls.
authoring_provenance.leakage_guard: Only documents published no later than as_of enter the corpus; the 2026 later episode remains label-side only.
